senses.gloss:
उर उर, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi said to be of
the family of Vāta.

उरा उरा, f. (fr. rt. वृ?), Ved. a ewe.
—उरा-मथि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. killing sheep.

उरक उरक, अस्, m., N. of one of Śiva's
attendants.

उरग उर-ग, अस्, m. (fr. उर = उरस् and
rt. गम्), a snake (‘going on the breast’); in
mythology a Nāga or semi-divine serpent usually re-
presented with a human face of great beauty; lead;
(ई), f. a female snake; (आ), f., N. of a town.
—उरग-
प्रतिसर, अस्, आ, अम्, having a serpent for a wedding
ring.
—उरग-भूषण, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva,
whose ornaments consist of snakes.
—उरग-राज,
अस्, m. the king of snakes, Śeṣa or Vāsuki.
—उरग-
सार-चन्दन, अस्, अम्, m. n. a kind of sandal-wood.
—उरग-स्थान, अम्, n. the abode of the Nāgas,
i. e. Pātāla, a region below the earth (not to be con-
founded with hell).
—उरगारि (˚ग-अरि), इस्, m. Garuḍa,
the bird of Viṣṇu; a large crane; (lit. ‘the enemy of
the snakes.’)
—उरगाशन (˚ग-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of
Garuḍa; a gigantic crane; (‘whose food consists of
serpents.’)
—उरगास्य (˚ग-आस्˚), अम्, n. a kind of
spade.
—उरगेन्द्र (˚ग-इन्˚), अस्, m. the king of
the snakes, Śeṣa or Vāsuki.
उरङ्-ग and उरङ्-गम, अस्, m. a snake.

उरण उरण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 4. ऋ),
a ram, a sheep, a young ram; a certain demon slain
by Indra; a cloud?; (ई), f. a ewe.
—उरणाक्ष
(˚ण-अक्˚) or उरणाक्षक, अस्, m. the plant Cassia
Alata or Tora.
—उरणाख्य (˚ण-आख्˚) or उरणा-
ख्यक, अस्, m. the plant Tora.

उराण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making broad, (Sāy. =
उरु-कुर्वाण.)
उरणक, अस्, m. a ram; a cloud.

उरभ्र उरभ्र, अस्, m. (fr. उर = ऊर्णा and
rt. भृ?), a ram; a kind of poisonous insect.

उररी उररी, ind. (perhaps connected with
उरु; cf. उरी, ऊरी, ऊररी), a particle implying assent,
admission, extension, expansion, diffusion; often com-
pounded with the roots, अस्, भू, and कृ.

ऊररी ऊररी, ind. a particle of assent and
diffusion; ऊररी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, allowed, promised.
See उररी.

उररी-कृ, to allow, admit, assent.
—उररी-कार,
अस्, m. a promise, agreement; admission.
—उररी-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, promised, agreed; spread, ex-
tended, diffused.

उरस, अस्, आ, अम्, having a strong broad breast;
[]
(अम्), n. (at the end of compounds) best, most ex-
cellent.

उरस् उरस्, n. (fr. rt. वृ, to cover; cf. उरु),
the breast, the bosom; (आस्, आस्, अस्), best, excellent;
उरसि कृ, to press any one to one's breast; to assent.
—उरः-क्षत, अम्, n. injury to the chest, breaking
a blood-vessel in the chest, consumption.
—उरः-
सूत्रिका, f. a pearl necklace hanging over the breast.
—उरः-स्थल, अम्, n. the breast, the bosom.
—उरश्-छद, अस्, m. a cuirass, breastplate, armour,
mail.
—उरसि-ज or उरसि-रुह, अस्, m. the female
breast (lit. ‘produced on the chest’).
—उरसि-लोमन्,
आ, आ, अ, having hairs on the breast.
—उरस्-कट, अस्,
m. the sacrificial thread hung round the neck and
upon the breast, as sometimes worn.
—उरस्-तस्, ind.
from the breast, in the direction of the breast.
—उरस्-
त्राण, अम्, n. a breastplate, cuirass, coat of mail.
—उरस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, broad-chested, full-breasted,
strong.
—उरो-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going on the breast
(as a reptile), creeping, crawling.
—उरो-ग्रह, अस्,
m. disease of the chest, pleurisy.
—उरो-घात, अस्,
m. striking or beating the breast; pain in the chest.
—उरो-ज, अस्, m. the female breast (lit. ‘born on the
chest’).
—उरो-बृहती, f., N. of a metre.
—उरो-
भूषण, अम्, n. an ornament of the breast.

उरसिल, अस्, आ, अम्, broad-chested, having a full
or broad breast.
1. उरस्य, nom. P. उरस्यति, -यितुम्, to be strong.

2. उरस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, situated in the breast; pec-
toral; (labour or exertion) requiring an effort of the
chest; legitimate (as a son or daughter); one born
from a married couple of the same tribe or caste;
excellent (i. e. the very heart, the breast or best part).

उराह उराह, अस्, m. a horse of a pale colour
with dark legs; (probably a foreign word.)

ऊरव्य, अस्, m. a man of the third or Vaiśya tribe
as born from the thighs of Brahmā.

उरसि-कृ or उरसि कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to
appropriate, make one's own.
